applies_why: The judge text states RESULT: DEFENDER WINS and a corrected HELD-1, so the rule governing when HELD gives DEFENDER WINS applies.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: Phrase: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count. Readings weighed: (1) the retraction removes the stated reason, so the standing cannot support DEFENDER WINS; (2) only the collision grade is retracted while the standing's stated reason remains countable.
why: The text still awards DEFENDER WINS even though the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN collision and the standing's stated reason were retracted, so the rule's condition is not met.
